Press Present and play the show (or export a video): each word lights up as the narration says it.
How it works

It takes three steps. First, the voice model reads the script aloud. Second, the speech model listens again and notes when each word begins. Third, the slide uses those times to reveal its text.

What timing buys you

PaceThe slide never runs ahead of the voice.
FocusThe audience reads what they hear.
PolishNothing appears too early or too late.
Timing buys you three things. Pace, because the slide never runs ahead of the voice. Focus, because the audience reads what they hear. And polish, because nothing appears a moment too early or too late.

That is all it takes. Thanks for watching.
